_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: classical (hellenic) backbone + mesoamerican (mayan) overlay (cross-family blend, Hellenic-leaning)

blend.backbone: classical (hellenic register: the polis and the oracle, -os/-on/-e/-eus endings, aspirates th/ph/kh, patronymic -id-, vowel-rich open syllables, root-penultimate stress, the archon and the basileus)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (mayan: the jungle city-states of the witz-pyramid and the carved stela, the ballgame and the bloodletting-rite, glottalized stops and the agentive aj-/ix-, the jade/cacao/maize wealth, the day-lord calendar that orders the realm beneath the oracle)
blend.lean: Hellenic-heavy - a Hellenic oracle-aristocracy (an archon-house keeping the Delphic seer-sanctuaries) enthroned over the Maya jungle-cities of pyramid and ball-court: the polis-rite rules, the jade-temple and the day-keeper endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_07 (Achillean / Hellenic) x BASE_10 (Ixalan / Mayan). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parents are Civilized (feudal), so Oracmaya is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Hellenic oracle-and-polis people who settled the jungle pyramid-cities of the Maya and married the two rites - the Delphic priestess and the feathered-serpent seer, the amphitheatre and the ball-court, the marble portico and the jade-temple ('the oracle of the maya'). Backbone = Classical/Hellenic (the ruling oracle-aristocracy, the archon/basileus register, the patronymic -ides, polis institutions); overlay/substrate = Mayan (the witz-pyramid cities, the k'uh-nah temples, the day-keeper calendar, the jungle/material/staple lexicon, the carved stela). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Hellenic and Maya registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Hellenic reflexes PRIMARY, Mayan morphs SECONDARY), never real gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved commonly-known foreign term - 'Archon' set for the county); conlang forms live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Register choice: Hellenic-base hybrids default to the Achillean reflexes (Tulrios/Orlandros), with the Mayan morph-set (Tulax/Orlanab) as the substrate variants.

phonology.palette: Hellenic backbone - vowel-rich (a e i o u + long e/o), aspirates th/ph/kh, liquids l/r, sibilant s, stops p t k b d g, -os/-on/-e/-eus endings, patronymic -id-, penultimate stress, open syllables - meeting a Mayan overlay: glottalized b'/t'/k'/tz'/ch', x (= sh), vowel length and final glottal stop, the agentive prefixes aj- (he of) / ix- (she of), -aj/-il/-an/-tun/-ab endings, CVC. Per the CSV: glottal stops with precise articulation under a Hellenic vowel-rich frame; grammar shifts toward SVO with complex vigesimal aspect-marking (the Maya day-count substrate) carried on Hellenic stems. Theophoric on the Hellenic reflexes (Tulrio-, Orlandro-) with Mayan agentive variants (Aj-Tulax, Ix-Rialtaj).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Hellenic clusters (kt, pt, st, ph, th, kh, ps) meeting Maya glottalization, vowel-final Hellenic endings (-os/-on/-e) imposed over Maya CVC roots; penultimate stress with the Maya glottal-stop articulation retained on substrate words; Hellenic patronymic compounds over aj-/ix- + Noh-/Chak- toponym prefixes.

sound_changes: Mayan glottalized stops and glottal stop -> Hellenic inventory: b'>b, t'>t, k'>k, tz'>tz, ch'>ch, final glottal-stop>0
Mayan consonant-final CVC roots take a Hellenic vowel-final ending: bare roots gain -os/-on/-a (or keep -an/-ab as a Hellenic-readable coda)
Hellenic penultimate stress on all words; Hellenic clusters (kt, pt, st, ph, th, kh, ps) permitted
retain Hellenic th/ph/kh and the diphthong -eu-, and the Maya x (= sh) and aj-/ix- agentive; very short roots take a Hellenic -os/-on
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/material/staple words from Mayan roots (the jungle-substrate works the land: witz>*witzos*, k'aax>*kaaxon*, kakaw>*kakaos*); rule/kin/civic/learned/abstract words from Hellenic roots (the oracle-register: megas>*megos*, hieros>*hieros*, polis>*polis*); every root then filtered to one Hellenic phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Mayan jungle/material/staple-roots + Hellenic rule/kin/civic-roots, all run through one Hellenic-shaped sound-law (glottalization collapsed, Greek vowel-final endings imposed, penultimate stress); portmanteaus mark the married institutions (oracle-temple, ball-court) and bloodline. NOT a slash list.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Hellenic oracle-aristocracy keep a patronymic -ides/-ades (son of) plus the polis demonym; the Maya populace keep the ch'ib'al (lineage) name with the aj- (he of) / ix- (she of) prefix and calendar-day birth-names; the throne fuses both - an archon who carries an -ides line and a witz-seat dynasty.
morphology.compounding_rule: Hellenic [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with linking -o- (Megos-oros, the great mountain) layered over Maya [quality|color] + feature prefixes (Chak-witz, red-pyramid; Noh-kah, great-town): the capital Oracmaya (the oracle of the maya), Mantekuh-Witz (the oracle-temple pyramid).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenic oracle-aristocracy over the Maya jungle-cities: the basileus and his dynastes-kin at the crown, the archon-governors over the poliskah-cities, the toparch-holders of the lesser seats; the ah-k'in day-keepers and the k'uh-nah priesthood serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Hellenic ladder, ascending, with the Maya substrate co-titles fused beneath. Toparch (district-lord) barony; Nakomarch (the Maya nakom war-captain fused to the Hellenic march) march; Eparch-Sajal (the provincial eparch over the Maya sajal governor) county - shown in DISPLAY as the approved foreign term 'Archon'; Strategos (general) duchy; Dynastes (prince-ruler) principality; Basileus (king) kingdom over a Basileia; Autokrator-Kalomte (the Hellenic autocrat fused to the Maya kalomte' high-king) empire over the Autokratoria. The conquered cities keep their Maya batab' (local chief) and ah-k'in (day-priest) beneath the Hellenic crown. Rank titles fuse the real Hellenic and Maya registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Diadochos (the successor-designate; the Maya call him the Baah-ch'ok, head-youth)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here 'Archon' for the county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Hellenic oracle-stock carry a personal name + patronymic (-ides) + polis demonym; the Maya populace carry a calendar-day given name + ch'ib'al lineage with aj-/ix-; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Hellenic oracle-aristocracy keep Greek personal + patronymic names (Theron Tulrides, Damon Orlandrides); the Maya city-folk keep calendar-day names (Aj-Balam, Ix-Sak-Nik) on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Hellenic devotional on the Achillean reflexes (Tulrides, Orlandros, Numenodoros); Maya devotional with aj-/ix-: Aj-Tulax (he of Tulax), Ix-Rialtaj (she of the mother), calendar-day-and-power names.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic reflexes PRIMARY (family_classical / achillean: Tulrios/Orlandros/Numenos, the -os/-on/-es Hellenic column), Mayan morphs SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican theonym_sets.mayan: Tulax/Orlanab/Numench), never real Greek/Maya gods (no Apollo, no Kukulkan). Shared pantheon; the oracle speaks in Hellenic names, the day-keeper in Maya names. Oracmaya allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The Delphic oracle-rite and the Maya bloodletting-and-day-count both bind the basileus to the powers; the manteion-portico and the witz-pyramid are twin altars.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (Hellenic; Maya Aj Ternaj) - the distant One, the unknowable source, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrios (Maya Tulax) - the sun, the oracle, and right-order; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaiandros (Maya Kayanab) - the enduring earth, the maize-ground
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numenos (Maya Numench) - air, sky-wisdom, the seer's breath
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rialta (Maya Ix Rialtaj) - the mother, mercy, the moon-and-maize

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiternos, Tulrios the just oracle, Orlandros of the sworn war, Rialta the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as daimones (Hellenic) / k'ak'as (Maya evil), warded; the oracle-rite and the day-count bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - honored and feared by turns; foregrounds the deified founder-heroes (the Heroes) and the uchben (Maya ancestral dead), the day-lords and the local k'uh (spirits) invoked at the manteion-grove and the witz situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiternos - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the bloodletting-rite turned to dread ends.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as daimones (Hellenic demons) or k'ak'as (Maya evil), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Maya Marakab the War-Fire); Vacidus -> Wakix the Devourer (Hellenic Wakidaimon the Void); Lusanto -> Lusankaan the Hoard-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Manteion (Hellenic oracle-temple) or K'uh-nah (Maya god-house) atop the witz (pyramid) of [power]: 'the Manteion of Tulrios', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Heroes (deified founder-heroes, venerated at a heroon) and the deified k'uhul ajaw ancestors (the uchben), honored at the heroon-tomb, the carved stela, and the pyramid-acropolis.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: a radiate sun-disc above the oracle-tripod and the bloodletting-stela
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandros: an iron spear crossed with the oath-ring and the war-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Rialta: the moon-rabbit cradling maize above the olive-branch
